body:
Fixes #2017

## Summary

- Added an atomic `SolveQueue.reserveStartSlot()` path for Telegram direct `/solve` starts.
- Made direct starts record the same global `lastStartTime` as queued starts, so `MIN_START_INTERVAL_MS` applies even when the queue is otherwise idle.
- Serialized overlapping direct-start reservations so concurrent Telegram commands cannot both pass the old timestamp.
- Preserved issue data, screenshot, related PR metadata, test logs, and case-study notes under `docs/case-studies/issue-2017`.

## Root Cause

Queued starts went through `SolveQueue.runConsumer()`, which recorded `lastStartTime` before launching. The Telegram `/solve` fast path launched immediately when the tool queue was empty and skipped that write, so a second immediate command could start before the 10-minute global interval elapsed.

## Verification

- `node tests/test-issue-2015-queue-stability.mjs` - 9 tests, 24 assertions.
- `node tests/solve-queue.test.mjs` - 71 assertions.
- `node tests/solve-queue-tool-tracking.test.mjs` - 11 assertions.
- `npm test` - all 305 selected default test files passed.
- `npm run lint`
- `npm run format:check`
- `bash scripts/check-file-line-limits.sh`
- `npx secretlint --secretlintrc <recommended preset> docs/case-studies/issue-2017`

Local `npm ci` logs include expected engine warnings because this workspace uses Node 20.20.2 while the package declares Node `>=24.0.0`.
